title: Manuel Perez as a favorite trumpeter
summary: Roubleau calls Manuel Perez an excellent, sweet trumpet player.

blocks.x: Any other favorite bands that you might have heard, though, even just once or twice? Or other musicians that your favorite other instruments that you can remember, the old timers? I know it's hard to remember all those people. There's so many here, I guess.

Manuel Perez is a national trumpet player. He's... under the fact. Very sweet trumpet player. Excellent trumpet player.
